terra.problem: “Sheba hides in the city” goes beyond 2 Samuel 20:14–15, which says he went there and was besieged but does not say he hid.
The woman says she is among the peaceable and faithful in Israel; she does not explicitly describe the whole city that way.
The title “Sheba’s head thrown over the wall” states that it happened, but 2 Samuel 20:20–21 only records the woman’s promise. It happens in verse 22.
Words and phrases such as “besieged,” “inheritance,” and “lifted his hand against” may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader. Use simpler wording or explain them.
